Name: Fishing Minigame Music
Author: Mindstormman
Description:
[heading][b]Add custom music to the fishing minigame![/b][/heading]
By default, the mod will play unused music tracks from the base game. These do not fit very well and it is highly recommended you change them following the instructions below.

Default Tracks:
[url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ycVTGbuK3IfR-Zeu4Xh02QCIIhhCGB1I/view?usp=sharing]Archaeo[/url] (Main Track)
[url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1LFTXU-H4AEQH-5-kQ5BuCF97i5nDjzZK/view?usp=sharing]Sappy Piano[/url] (Alt Track)

[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ (Optional)
[/list]
[heading][b]How to use[/b][/heading][list]
[*]Extract the .zip to your mods folder
[*]Find a music track to add to the minigame
[*]Convert it to .wav and name it 'archaeo.wav'
[*]Move it to 'Mods/[CP] Fishing Music/assets'
[*]If you want to add an alt track (enable in config), name a track 'sappypiano.wav' and add it to the same location
[*]You're all good to go!
[/list]
